Kwame, the review is booked for today (Mon 19 Oct) from 15:00 to 15:30 with you and Bettina.

I left the night-dispatch contact's name out of the event notes. You gave me that name in a direct message and asked me to keep it there. Bettina can see the notes, so it would have gone to someone who wasn't part of that message. If you want the name in the notes, tell me here and I'll add it.
